profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary: Customer focused software engineer with experience in the defense industry, healthcare, and infosec.  I enjoy building teams, problem solving, and positions which let me see the impact of my day to day work on my customers.

positions.title: Principal Security Engineer
positions.description: Engineering lead focused on election and ballot security.

positions.title: Member Of Technical Staff
positions.description: Senior member of a team focused on identifying and fixing customer facing issues in the Carbon Black NGAV Defense product.  My manager and I created multiple, geographically diverse teams to diagnose and correct endpoint and cloud focused issues, including hiring and training of new engineers.
positions.insights: Computer Science, Software Troubleshooting and +10 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Member of a team supporting a best in class cyber security and application control product.  
Duties include debugging performance and stability issues with the endpoint sensor and control server, identifying customer issues and advising on remediation, advocating for and implementing customer focused improvements, and building internal tools.
positions.insights: Computer Science, System Software and +11 skills

positions.title: Software Team Lead
positions.description:
Lead software engineer for an aircraft protection R&D, agile team. 
Primarily responsibilities included requirements implementation and testing, managing junior engineers, and implementation of software security and anti-tamper capabilities.
positions.insights: Computer Science, Requirements Analysis and +9 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technical professional creating aircraft protection systems focused on missile defense and hostile fire detection.
*Team lead responsible for design and implementation of system security and diagnostics
*Complex embedded software, primarily implemented in C++
*Member of a geographically diverse and agile team

Previous projects include... 

Creation of a systems integration lab, designing a software interface to link diverse commercial test equipment for complex simulations including flight motion simulators and a targeting array. 

A major hardware upgrade to a flagship product line.  Responsible for design and implementation of an onboard data recording system as well as assisting the system's first major testing milestone.
positions.insights: Computer Science, Requirements Analysis and +5 skills
